run_metadata.coverage_summary: Degraded, SEARCH-ONLY run — the same hard egress constraint seen on every recent run persisted. The session network policy denied all direct HTTPS to tender hosts: a curl probe to https://www.tenders.gov.au returned '403 CONNECT tunnel failed' (a policy denial, confirmed in the agent proxy's recentRelayFailures, not retried per proxy guidance) and WebFetch returned DNS ENOTFOUND for www.tenders.gov.au (host outside the session's allowed network domains). No buyer-originated portal, detail page, feed/API or tender document could be opened, so discovery was limited to the WebSearch tool, which is US-indexed and returned mostly cached mid-2026 snapshots, JavaScript-disabled portal shells, and third-party aggregator pages (australiantenders.com.au, developmentaid.org, bidsfactory.com). Tier 1 (AusTender, NSW buy.nsw, VIC Buying for Victoria, QLD QTenders/supply.qld.gov.au, WA/SA/TAS, NT QTOL, ACT) were swept by search only. Tier 2 (councils via VendorPanel; universities/TAFEs; water/energy GBEs; Australia Post; public health) and Tier 3 (SAP Ariba Discovery/Business Network, BHP/Rio Tinto/Fortescue/Woodside, major retail/bank/telco buyer portals) were checked by search. Every corporate channel remained registration-gated or invitation-only with no publicly-visible open RFx. Three buyer-originated government/public-sector opportunities that appeared genuinely open were surfaced from cached search snippets and are carried at headline level only, each explicitly flagged UNVERIFIED against the primary portal. No opportunity was fabricated; leads that resolved to closed or invitation-only notices were excluded and noted in gaps.
gaps: HARD EGRESS BLOCK: all direct HTTPS to tender hosts denied by the session network policy (403 CONNECT tunnel failed / DNS ENOTFOUND — hosts outside allowed domains). This has now blocked full discovery on multiple consecutive runs. To restore full discovery, at minimum these hosts must be allowed in the session network settings: www.tenders.gov.au, www.tenders.nsw.gov.au (buy.nsw.gov.au), www.tenders.vic.gov.au, qtenders.hpw.qld.gov.au / supply.qld.gov.au, www.tenders.wa.gov.au, www.tenders.sa.gov.au, www.tenders.tas.gov.au, tendersonline.nt.gov.au, www.tenders.act.gov.au, www.vendorpanel.com.au, service.ariba.com, gateway.icn.org.au, and individual council/university sites.

All three carried tenders are UNVERIFIED headline-level entries drawn from cached search snippets and/or aggregator pages; their tender_id, buyer, dates and scope could not be confirmed on the buyer-originated primary portal this run. They need a detail/verification pass once egress is restored.
No deliverables / requirements / evaluation-criteria extraction was possible for any opportunity — every detail page and tender document was unreachable.

Tier 3 corporate (SAP Ariba Discovery, BHP, Rio Tinto, Fortescue, Woodside, Woolworths, Coles, Qantas, Telstra, major banks) remained registration-gated or invitation-only; no authenticated supplier session is available, so no corporate opportunity could be read. Recorded as portals only, consistent with prior runs. No corporate tender was fabricated.

Excluded leads (not fabricated): Maranoa Regional Council (QLD) open tenders surfaced with closing dates of 4 Nov and 9 Nov 2026 — already closed as of this run date and excluded. Transport for NSW Mona Vale Road West EOI (published 30 Jul 2026) closed 11 Sep 2026 — excluded. University EOIs surfaced (ACU, Newcastle, Melbourne, Victoria University, Sydney, CQUniversity) all had 2026 closing dates already passed — excluded.
WebSearch is US-indexed and returned predominantly stale or aggregator data; genuinely recent (last 24-48h) buyer-originated notices are almost certainly undercounted this run.
recommended_seed_additions: ICN Gateway (Industry Capability Network) — https://gateway.icn.org.au — buyer-originated project/work-package EOIs; recheck reachability once egress is restored.
